name: Inert Scourgestones
label: Quest
description: Inert Scourgestones: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The evil has been purged from the stones, friend.
I am aware of Commander Ashlam's plans, and he will require only a single inert stone. Bring it to him so we may bathe the Scourge in righteous fire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Was Thal'danis able to cleanse the scourgestones?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done as I asked without question, friend.
Trust is achieved, it seems. Perhaps I can reveal our plan in more detail to you now.
